title: They Were Heard
text:
Some shots

were heard last night


They were heard

from the cemetery side.


Nobody knows

whom they killed,

or whether they killed them.

Nobody knows anything.


Some shots were heard

last night.


That is all.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's report-like restraint and the uncertainty around the killing.

title: She Was Sold
text:
She was sold

to Kelly & Martínez

Co. Ltd.,


and many will send her

silver gifts


And others will send her

electroplate gifts,


and her former lover

sends her this epigram.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the bitter commercial framing and the epigram as the lover's only gift.

title: You Who Are Proud
text:
You who are proud

of my verses


But not because

I wrote them


But because

you inspired them


And even though they were

against you


you could have inspired

better poetry


you could have inspired

better poetry
editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated reproach that the beloved might have inspired better poems.

title: "I Have No Other," I Have Told Him
text:
"I have no other," I have told him

and repeated many times.

And I heard him saying inside me

not in words, confusedly,

but precise, he was saying inside me

or from the bottom of the universe:

"And I have no other but you"
editorial_note: The translation preserves the prayerlike exchange as an inner voice or a voice from the universe.

title: Epigram XXXVI
text:
I have handed out

clandestine leaflets

shouting

long live freedom!

in the middle of the street

defying the

armed guards

I took part in the

April rebellion

but I turn pale

when I pass your house

and your mere glance
editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's contrast between public bravery and the beloved's disarming glance.
